title: Apple Vision Pro 2 leaks: what changed and is it worth it?

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the Vision Pro 2 isn’t just a device, but a step toward a new kind of human-computer symbiosis?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: The new retina display and eye-tracking tech make for seamless AR experiences, but the real leap is in neural interface compatibility with third-party apps.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Increased immersion risks blurring reality, especially for vulnerable users—could lead to addiction or psychological dissonance.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are integrating ethical guardrails, like usage timers and reality-check prompts, to mitigate overuse and maintain mental well-being.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If designed responsibly, this could revolutionize education, enabling immersive, personalized learning that adapts in real time.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The Vision Pro 2 may redefine how we interact with the world—if we build it with both ambition and accountability.

video_cue: A person wearing the Vision Pro 2 interacting with a holographic interface in a sleek, futuristic office.
